segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Two things today: the new empty states, and the progress meter, which tested badly.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Four of six first-time users read the meter as a loading bar.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: I can't commit to a launch date until we know the meter works.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: I'll rework it and retest with five new users before product review.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: Also, that stepper isn't in the system. We have three steppers in production now.

segments.speaker: S3
segments.text: Let me audit the variants before anyone builds a fourth.
